correctness.rationale: Known coefficientwise T_p(X)=X^p+X mod p, Fermat, and the integer pth difference p! establish ν_p(d_p)=1 for every prime. The Gertsch–Robert Touchard recurrence has squarefree characteristic Y^q−Y−x for nonzero x; every root lies in F_(q^q)^×, yielding n-period q^q−1 for all residue inputs. Zero input is handled for n≥1. Hence q divides the universal fixed divisor for every prime p ≡ q mod q^q−1, and Dirichlet supplies infinitely many such p. Exhaustive modular recurrence tables over one established period for q=2 and 3 prove the stated iff criteria. Standard-library verifier passed finite diagnostics, no finite experiment treated as an infinite proof.

A sharp valuation at the index prime, auxiliary factors of unbounded size along infinitely many prime indices, and exact 2/3-residue criteria offer global structure not supplied by isolated evaluations or by coefficientwise Touchard congruence alone. The work makes no claim to classify d_p completely.
